purpose: Test whether the micro-02 quote-integrity calibration signal transfers to three untouched formal-news AI-polish texts when only an exact source quote and its attribution are restored.

corpus_binding.selection_basis: Previously unscanned formal-news pairs containing a materially altered direct quote with a unique exact source excerpt; no detector score was consulted.

hypothesis.confirmatory: Restoring one materially altered direct quote and its source-proven attribution will reduce the median score by more than measured same-SHA noise and 2 percentage points in both ZeroGPT and Copyleaks on every eligible holdout sample.
hypothesis.cross_service_guardrail: The Scribbr/QuillBot-family score may not worsen by more than 2 percentage points on any eligible sample.
hypothesis.human_control: A detector response is interpretable only beside the untouched human source score for the same article.
hypothesis.not_a_recipe: Quoted language is copied from the exact bound source because the AI-polish version changed the quotation. The factor does not authorize inventing quotes, changing an author's own prose into a quotation, or editing an accurate quote for a detector.

quality.style_exception: Exact quotations are fidelity-protected and may not be adapted to optimize a noisy short-text style metric.

quality.source_rebaseline_reason: The AI-polish quote introduced a permission formulation absent from the source; the candidate restores the unique literal source quote while retaining the same vessel, 68,000-ton anchor and named speaker.

primary_effect.access_rule: guest result only; do not register, pay or infer a score from loading

diagnostic.reason: No-sign-up independent family with severe observed formal/scientific human false positives; it cannot substitute for Copyleaks and must include the human control.

repeat_policy.no_adaptive_repeats: Do not add repeats or stop a complete cell early because of a favorable or unfavorable score.

procedure: Rebuild all three candidates from the exact AI text, bound human reference and frozen plan; reject any plan, source excerpt, original, reference or candidate SHA mismatch.
Use fresh service tabs. Within each service, scan samples in order news-quote-01, news-quote-02, news-quote-03; within each sample scan human, AI, candidate.
Before every submit, compute the exact visible-text SHA-256. Every included scan must match the frozen role SHA.

After every submit, require loading, disabled-state, changed result text or another explicit transition before accepting terminal DOM state. first_scan_no_prior_result is allowed only once per fresh service tab.
Record complete, blocked or error honestly. A guest limit, registration wall, timeout or non-terminal loader is not a percentage and does not permit service substitution.
Do not create, alter, combine, reorder or replace candidates after this preregistration is committed.
No detector result may override quote fidelity, actor, number, modality, formal-news genre or C2 preservation.

success_criteria.sample_eligible: For each primary service, the AI baseline median is at least 20%, all required AI/candidate repeats are complete and exact-SHA, and both same-SHA ranges are at most 5 points.
success_criteria.primary_service_effect: Candidate median is lower than AI baseline by more than max(2.0 points, baseline range, candidate range).
success_criteria.sample_success: Both ZeroGPT and Copyleaks satisfy primary_service_effect and Scribbr median does not worsen by more than 2 points.
success_criteria.transfer_signal: All three holdout samples satisfy sample_success; two of three is reported as partial 66.7%, not rounded up to the protocol's 70% requirement.
success_criteria.hard_threshold_context: This holdout tests transfer of one source-correction factor. Remaining scores may exceed 20%; production F1 remains red until every mandatory project service is strictly below 20%.
success_criteria.production_admission: Holdout success alone cannot admit a rule: the calibration requirement of four texts, human-control aggregate, capture limitations and all PROTOCOL.md thresholds still apply.

stopping_rules: If a frozen candidate fails exact source, fidelity, CEFR or plan reinspection, do not scan it and record quality rejection.
If a service is blocked or non-terminal, record the terminal limitation and continue only with already preregistered services; never substitute a new detector after scores are visible.
If transition-safe instrumentation cannot distinguish a new result from the prior result, exclude that attempt and stop the affected cell rather than guessing.
Do not expand the edit budget, add punctuation or synonym variants, or use detector highlights to alter these holdout candidates.
